meta.name: internal-comms
meta.description: Plan, sequence, and pressure-test internal announcements before they send. Use when announcing a reorg, policy, or product change, drafting an all-hands or exec update, or deciding who hears what and in which order.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 宣布重组或政策前,规划内部通告顺序并对消息做压力测试。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要让公司全员知悉重大变动,又怕消息泄露或顺序混乱。
copy.tagline_en: Plan and pressure-test internal announcements for reorgs or policy changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate who hears about a big internal change and when.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审查内部公告草稿，按五个必需元素评分并指出要改的地方；也会根据变更内容和受众安排发布顺序和时间；还会推荐最合适的发布渠道。
howto.when: 当你宣布重组、政策变更、全员大会等内部消息，或决定谁知道什么、按什么顺序时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这份重组公告跑一遍审查，列出要改的地方。
say.note: Claude 会按五个必需元素评分并给修改建议。

say.text: 这次新政策要通知三组人，帮我排个发布顺序和时间表。
say.note: Claude 会生成带日期的分步沟通计划。

say.text: 这份产品迁移通知，帮我选个最合适的发布渠道。
say.note: Claude 会按六个维度评分推荐渠道。

howto.what_en: Claude audits internal announcement drafts, scores them on five required elements, and suggests fixes. It can also sequence who hears what and when, and recommend suitable channels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to announce a reorg, policy, or product change, draft an all-hands or exec update, or decide who hears what and in which order.

say_en.text: Run this reorg announcement through the audit and list what to fix.
say_en.note: Claude scores it on five elements and gives fixes.

say_en.text: This new policy affects three groups; help me sequence the announcement.
say_en.note: Claude builds an ordered plan with dates.

say_en.text: Recommend a channel for this product migration notice.
say_en.note: Claude ranks channels by six dimensions.
